question: 30% of the students are girls. If the number of girls is 360, find the total number of students.
explanation: Here, 30% of the students equals 360. | \[\Rightarrow 30\%\rightarrow360\] | To determine the value of 1%, divide 360 by 30. | \[\Rightarrow 1\%=\frac{360}{30}=12\] | Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the whole. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%=12\times100=1200\] | Therefore the total students is 1200. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Total students}=1200\]
